_comment: Single source of truth for the RCI Tabung Haji data graphic. Read by src/pages/infographics/rci-tabung-haji.astro and by the render scripts in this directory, so the page and the share cards can never drift. Every figure carries the paragraph and page it comes from. RM million unless stated.

source.title: Laporan Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja bagi Menyiasat Isu Pengurusan dan Operasi Lembaga Tabung Haji dari Tahun 2014 hingga 2020

steps.label: Reported profit
steps.note: The figure depositors were told, and the figure the 2017 distribution was declared on.

steps.label: Equity write-downs
steps.note: Available-for-sale shareholdings carried above what they were worth. Larger than the reported profit on its own.

steps.label: Debt instruments
steps.note: Fixed-income holdings. Shown at a minimum visible height so it does not disappear.

steps.label: Other adjustments
steps.note: Property fair-value losses and income recognised but not received.

steps.label: Restated loss
steps.note: A swing of RM4.8 billion inside one financial year, produced entirely by accounting choices.

threshold.computedBy: PwC sensitivity; illustration recorded by the commission

charges.note: charge if the trigger had stayed at −70%

position.auditBasisNote: The National Audit Department put 2017 liabilities at RM74,409 million against the same RM70,317 million of assets — a wider gap on a different basis (¶3.11.11, pp.93–94).

hibah.note: Runs to 2020 because the commission's table does. Ending the series at the 2018 trough would be a truncation of the same class as a cut axis.

hajCost.computedBy: TH projection, recorded by the commission
hajCost.note: The commission's prose puts the 2030 figure at up to RM35,000 while the table it reproduces gives RM37,729. We use the table.

Investment losses TH says it has addressed
